headline: The GTT gap is widening: 5 stale GTTs are live and 20 shorts have no GTT, while the 4 stopped-out spreads are still open.

points.label: Protection is falling behind
points.text: 20 short options now have no protective GTT (new spreads on BAJAJFINSV, BANKINDIA and CAMS were added on top of the earlier ones). Placing GTTs through the tool failed on the first attempt, so these need placing in Kite or a retry. Every unprotected short is a loss no rule is watching.

points.label: Stale GTTs keep multiplying
points.text: 5 stale GTTs are now active: APOLLOHOSP, BPCL, KARURVYSYA 370PE and 410CE, and SUNPHARMA 2100CE. Each can buy a new long if it triggers, and two such GTTs already fired today (ABB, CANBK). Delete a short's GTT in the same sitting you close it.

points.label: Clean-up still open
points.text: The 4 stopped-out spreads are still open (about −₹97k on the short legs, hedges partly offsetting) and expire Monday. A MAHABANK buy-back order at ₹7.3 is sitting unfilled. KARURVYSYA, PFC, HINDZINC and SUNPHARMA still need closing.

points.label: Event rule broken on entry
points.text: CONCOR 410PE/400PE was opened inside the ex-dividend window (20 Nov, estimated), which the 15-day rule says to close immediately. Check results and ex-dividend dates before opening, not after.

points.label: Versus the backtest
points.text: The swing shares are +₹8.9k combined with 20 of 36 in profit and no drawdown, so there is nothing to compare yet: 5 weeks and 2 closed trades against −21.3% max drawdown and PF 1.75 tested. The options book (about −₹68k open) is a bigger driver of your account than the shares right now.

points.label: Decision
points.text: Stop opening new option trades until the protection and clean-up gap is closed. New spreads add margin and tail risk while today's open problems are still unresolved. Resume once every short has a GTT and the 4 stopped-out spreads are closed.

action: Delete the 5 stale GTTs, close the 4 stopped-out spreads and CONCOR, protect the 20 shorts, and open no new option trades until that is done.
